high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic for the movie "Rogue One: A Star Wars Story." It features a character from the film, Jyn Erso, portrayed by Felicity Jones. The background is a starry space scene, evoking the vastness of the galaxy in which the story takes place. The text on the right side of the image is a quote attributed to Jyn Erso, delivered during a pivotal moment in the film. The quote reads: "What chance do we have? The question is 'What choice?' Run? Hide? Plead for mercy? Scatter your forces? You give way to an enemy
